title: Kaiju
name: kaiju
short_description: Giant monsters for Mineclonia and VoxeLibre: Gojira, Mothra, King Ghidorah and Cthulhu.
long_description: Four giant monsters with their own models, animations and fighting styles. Gojira breathes fire and smashes through forests and houses; Mothra guards the skies with wing gusts and poison powder; King Ghidorah walks and flies, fires gravity beams from three heads that grow back; Cthulhu sleeps on the sea floor and drags intruders under water. They fight each other too. Spawn eggs only, no natural spawning. Block destruction can be switched off.
